name: Black Forest Labs (FLUX)
summary: FLUX image generation and editing (FLUX.2 [pro]/[max], FLUX1.1 [pro]) from Black Forest Labs' own API.

api_key.description: a Black Forest Labs API key (dashboard.bfl.ai, per project). Sent in the x-key header.

notes: Every generation is asynchronous: submit, then poll the returned polling_url until status is Ready (or pass webhook_url).
Generated images are served from delivery.*.bfl.ai URLs that expire after 10 minutes.
Billing is in credits, 1 credit = $0.01; FLUX.2 is priced by output resolution tier (about 1, 2, 4 or 16 megapixels).
api.eu.bfl.ai and api.us.bfl.ai are regional alternatives to the global api.bfl.ai; this entry uses the global host.
FLUX 3, video, Kontext, fill/expand and finetune endpoints are not in this entry.

endpoints.name: Generate or edit an image with FLUX.2 [pro]
endpoints.summary: Text-to-image, or image editing with up to 8 reference images; BFL's recommended default model.

prompt.description: Text prompt; for edits, the instruction.
prompt.example: a red fox in fresh snow, golden hour

input_image.description: Image to edit or use as a reference: a URL (simplest) or encoded image. Leave out for text-to-image.

input_image_2.description: Reference image 2, same form as input_image.

input_image_3.description: Reference image 3, same form as input_image.

input_image_4.description: Reference image 4, same form as input_image.

input_image_5.description: Reference image 5, same form as input_image.

input_image_6.description: Reference image 6, same form as input_image.

input_image_7.description: Reference image 7, same form as input_image.

input_image_8.description: Reference image 8, same form as input_image.

width.description: Output width in pixels, at least 64; unset follows the input or the default.

height.description: Output height in pixels, at least 64.

disable_pup.description: true turns off the automatic prompt upsampling FLUX.2 [pro] and [max] apply. Default false.

safety_tolerance.description: Moderation tolerance 0 (strictest) to 7, default 2; levels your account is not approved for return 422.

webhook_url.description: URL to notify when the task finishes, instead of polling.

notes: Asynchronous: the answer is {id, polling_url, cost}. Poll that polling_url (or blackforestlabs.result.get with the id) until status is Ready, then download result.sample.
Spends credits (1 credit = $0.01); the answer's cost field gives the charge.

prompt_upsampling.description: Let the model rewrite the prompt for more creative output. Default false.

endpoints.name: Get a task's result
endpoints.summary: Status of a generation task and, when Ready, the signed URL of the output.

id.description: Task id returned by the submit call.

notes: Status is one of Task not found, Pending, Reasoning, Generating, Request Moderated, Content Moderated, No Card Generated, Ready, Error.
BFL requires polling the polling_url the submit call returned, which may sit on another cluster host; this call on api.bfl.ai can answer Task not found for a task routed elsewhere.
result.sample expires 10 minutes after the result is ready: download it at once.
